integration_defects_found_and_fixed.fix: clear the Thumb state bit before range, alignment and split-field encoding

integration_defects_found_and_fixed.mechanism: generic BOLT symbolization attached the one long-target relocation to operand zero even though Branch Future instructions carry multiple PC-relative operands

integration_defects_found_and_fixed.fix: bind R_ARM_THM_BF16/BF12/BF18 only to operand one; preserve the short location and after-target operands

low_overhead_loop_policy.behavior: the containing function is retained whole and reports simple=false and firmware_modified=false
low_overhead_loop_policy.reason: FirmBOLT does not yet represent architectural low-overhead-loop state in its CFG, dataflow and exception contracts
low_overhead_loop_policy.claim: relocation and exact-retention support only; no optimization or speedup claim

scope_limits: Branch Future relocation correctness does not model or authorize low-overhead-loop CFG transformations

the unchanged production matrix demonstrates no regression across the existing firmware corpus, not complete x86-backend parity
